rules.statement: The RTL must comply with VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2.

RTL uses one synthesizable module per .sv file with matching filename, structural top, ANSI ports (input wire, output logic, inout wire only for pad wrappers), rule-compliant names, unsigned four-state logic, explicit widths, only always_comb/always_ff, named connections, and logic-section comments.
RTL must not use package, plain always, always_latch, two-state or signed types, define/undef, latches, multiple drivers, or unsynthesizable test code.
